text:
leah: FYI ACME POC blocked — SCIM provisioning returning 403 on Dedicated tenant, demo next week.

tom: 403 payload? usually scope or wrong endpoint.

leah: Their logs: `HTTP 403 {"detail":"service account lacks scim:write scope"}` Token came from our sales console.

maya: Quick check: token scopes, dedicated vs hosted account, and base SCIM URL. I can inspect tenant.

maya: Tenant shows legacy `users:manage` scope only. New `scim:write` missing. I can create a new token with scim scopes and stage rotation.

onboarding-bot: Ticket created POC-2293, assigned maya/tom.

leah: Also seeing intermittent SSO failures: NameID format mismatch in SAML for some users.

sam: Ask their IdP to set NameID to emailAddress or provide SAMLResponse so we can confirm.

tom: Plan: maya prepares token rotation; sam validates SAML mapping. Leah please request SAML trace and SCIM attempt timestamps.

leah: They sent Okta logs — NameID shows `persistent` for legacy users. They prefer minimal changes on their side.

sam: We could add a short-lived gateway shim to map persistent NameID to email via SCIM lookup for POC, but need eng-runtime signoff.

maya: I'll stage token with `scim:read,scim:write,users:manage` and wait for ACME approval to swap.

leah: They asked for a Hosted API key to smoke test while we fix Dedicated. Can we issue a short-lived hosted key?

sam: Security OK with 12h hosted key, read-only, limited quotas, with audit logging.

leah: Sent hosted test key securely and scheduled rotation window at 14:00 PT. 30m rollback.

onboarding-bot: POC-2293 scheduled swap at 14:00 PT.

leah: Post-rotation: SCIM sync now 200 and users provisioned. Some legacy users still hit SAML NameID mismatch; customer will update IdP for full fix. POC green for demo.

tom: Follow-ups: auto-migrate legacy tokens to include scim:write and evaluate persistent->email mapping as a supported option.

sam: I'll log security notes for temporary hosted key.

maya: I'll run migration job for pre-flag tokens next week.

leah: Thanks team — ACME demo ready. :tada:
